target.description: a .poly, .policy.poly or .ts module, or a project directory

root.description: where .poly/ lives (default: the project directory, or the working directory)

host.description: a tsconfig naming host code to compile against the generated declarations (PT28.1d)

config.description: a module only: the configurations to check, comma-separated; the others are listed as not run (PT14a)

goals.description: a module only: a JSON file of goals, { configuration, name, expr, path }, each reached or PL5410 (PS13.10, PT14a)

defects.description: a module only: a JSON file of seeded defects, each checked in place of the module (PT14a)

only.description: with defects: the defects to check, comma-separated

cache.description: the result cache directory; none when absent (the command line passes .poly/cache beside the source) (PT14a)

noCache.description: neither read nor write the result cache (PT14a)
